_about: Genre presets for Video Studio (editor brain). Numbers are working conventions from research_notes (Murch, Cutting ASL data, MrBeast memo - leaked/unofficial, platform specs) - heuristics, tune per project. Used by autocut.py --genre, make_plan.py --genre, editor.py review --genre, story.py --genre.

_fields.autocut: max_gap s (pauses longer are cut), breath s kept before words, pad s after words, fillers remove|keep-natural|off, retakes, smart_cuts (quiet-point snapping), xfade_ms, jcut_frames; enabled=false means keep everything
_fields.interrupt_s: max seconds without a visual change
